claims.text: Plano's City Council agenda item buys ChatGPT Enterprise from Carahsoft Technology Corporation for $190,000 under state contract DIR-CPO-5683.
claims.quote: To approve the purchase and implementation of ChatGPT Enterprise Solution for Technology Solutions from Carahsoft Technology Corporation in the amount of $190,000 (DIR-CPO-5683)
claims.document: City of Plano Legistar, Matter 1967, File 26-884

claims.text: The same item buys the Darwin AI platform from Carahsoft Technology Corporation for $150,000 under state contract DIR-CPO-5687.

claims.document: City of Plano Legistar, Matter 1967, File 26-884

claims.text: It also buys Microsoft Enterprise from SHI Government Solutions for $10,000 under state contract DIR-CPO-5237.

claims.document: City of Plano Legistar, Matter 1967, File 26-884
